items.title: Spain orders NordVPN and ProtonVPN to block LaLiga stream piracy
items.description: A Spanish court has granted precautionary measures against NordVPN and ProtonVPN, ordering the two popular VPN providers to block 16 websites that facilitate piracy of football matches. [...]

items.title: Supply Chain Attack Embeds Malware in Android Devices
items.description: Keenadu downloads payloads that hijack browser searches, commit ad fraud, and execute other actions without user knowledge.
